descriptions.notStarted: There's a girl wandering around the Prendergast Mansion.  I wonder what she's looking for?
descriptions.inProgress: Sophilia is looking for her favorite toy - the very first doll her father made for her when she was a child.  She seems to have been looking for it for quite awhile.  She mentioned something about Ludmilla having a history of hiding her toys.  If I can find Sophilia's doll for her, maybe I can put her spirit at ease.
descriptions.completed: I gave Sophilia back her favorite doll.  She was so happy to get it back that she gave me some of her favorite candy.
